description: Dependency updates as pull requests, auto-merged when CI is green. See docs/adr/0015-renovate.md.

customManagers.description: Renovate's own image in the Renovate workflow, pinned by version and digest.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates of stable (≥ 1.0) dependencies once all required checks pass. Actions report versions as v1.2.3.
Type definitions only; CI type-checks every use.

Code that runs with repository secrets or on the owner's machine is reviewed, never auto-merged: workflow actions, pre-commit hooks and Renovate's image. A moved or backdated git tag passes the release age (docs/adr/0015-renovate.md).
One pull request for all non-major npm updates.
Playwright's npm packages and the CI image of the test jobs move together: the image holds the browsers of one Playwright version (docs/adr/0014-ci-hardening.md).
